## How to read this page {#legend}

Each evidence line is the newest worked run on that machine, from the run records in [`runs/`](https://github.com/project-delphi/marketing-statistics-workshop/tree/main/runs). A newer failure replaces an older pass. A run is *before the notebook or its deps last changed* when the notebook's code (content_sha) or the files, pins and ref it depends on (deps_sha) have changed since; it no longer counts.

*Ready to teach* needs a passing run on Colab, the runtime the notebook is designed for: worked (reference solutions bound), the whole notebook, full settings (not QUICK), with the current code and deps, at most 21 days older than the newest record on this page. A laptop's, the Docker image's or the CI runner's time does not predict Colab's. The AWS paths are documented, not run.

*Learner mode* runs the notebook with nothing written: it must stop at the first checkpoint with the message that tells a participant how to go on.
